status: Provisional public gallery · identification, image, and rights review ongoing
description: Photographs associated with the Black Repertory Group's 1990 silver anniversary celebration.
gallery_description: The Black Repertory Group marked its silver anniversary in July 1990, celebrating its work in Black theater and community life. Photographs associated with the occasion show speakers, presentations, group portraits, and guests gathered around an anniversary cake.
gallery_source_note: The album title page identifies July 20–22, 1990, as the celebration dates; individual photograph dates have not been independently established. Identifications and reproduction rights remain under review.

title: Ronald V. Dellums — Twenty Years of Public Service Gala (1987)
description: Forty-one photographs by Jacob Blanchette of the May 31, 1987 Oakland gala honoring Congressman Ronald V. Dellums, accompanied by three public-facing printed artifacts.
status: Provisional public gallery · identification, image, and rights review ongoing
gallery_description: A celebration of Ronald V. Dellums’s first twenty years in elected office, held in Oakland on May 31, 1987.
gallery_source_note: The invitation establishes the advertised gala date, venue, and program, but not the date of each photograph or the attendance of advertised guests. Photographs are attributed to Jacob Blanchette by the collection steward; creators of the accompanying printed objects are unknown. Reproductions are preliminary non-generative phone-image crops. Individual identifications and reproduction rights remain under review.
credits: Gala photographs by Jacob Blanchette (family confirmation, November 2026). Printed ephemera creators not established.
gallery_history: Ronald V. Dellums entered elected office on the Berkeley City Council in 1967 and went on to represent the East Bay in Congress beginning in 1971. On May 31, 1987, supporters and guests gathered at the Hyatt Regency Hotel in Oakland to mark twenty years of his public service.

The invitation advertised Whoopi Goldberg as a special guest and music by the Ed Kelly Quintet, featuring Pharoah Sanders and Jules Broussard. Photographs associated with the evening show musicians performing, speakers addressing the gathering, a commemorative plaque being presented, and guests posing together. The invitation records the advertised program but does not, by itself, confirm who attended.
